result.topic_en: Notes on the potential at a point (x,y,z) of a function V that is infinite at a point (a,b,0) outside three surfaces, with cases depending on vanishing parameters, followed by remarks on the method of treating functions with discontinuities, and scattered calculations, partly upside down, at the bottom.
